name: @m2mfreedom/elizaos-plugin
description: Official ElizaOS plugin for M2M Freedom Market (https://m2mfreedom.com) — Autonomous HTTP 402 (x402 Base/Solana USDC & L402 Bitcoin Lightning) tools for AI agents: Ultra-Fast LLM Inference (10 Sats / $0.0094 USDC), 5-Sat Semantic Vector Embeddings, 12-in-1 CAPTCHA Solver, Stealth Anti-Bot Web Unlocker, Clean Markdown Scraper, Isolated Python 3 Quant Sandbox, Structured Table/Financial Extractor, Persistent K/V Memory Vault, 5-Sat Bitcoin Oracle, and M2M Task Clearinghouse (100/100 SLA).
author: M2M Market — Freedom Engine <Lordbryce@coinos.io> (https://m2mfreedom.com)

M2M_FREEDOM_PASS.description: Optional Prepaid M2M Session Pass token (m2m-pass-<hex>) from POST https://m2mfreedom.com/api/v1/router/topup for 0ms execution across all tools.

M2M_FREEDOM_X_PAYMENT.description: Optional x402 payment header value (Base64 EIP-3009 payload, 'base:<0xTxHash>', or 'solana:<TxSignature>'). Or pass an x402-paying fetch wrapper.

COINOS_API_TOKEN.description: Optional Coinos API Bearer token to automatically settle L402 Bitcoin Lightning invoices on 402 responses.

LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY.description: Optional LNbits Admin Key (used with LNBITS_URL) to automatically pay L402 Lightning invoices on 402 responses.

M2M_FREEDOM_MAX_PRICE_USD.description: Maximum allowed per-call spend cap in USD (default: 0.25).

M2M_FREEDOM_AUTO_FREE_TRIAL.description: Set 'true' to automatically use the 2-call Free Trial pass on eligible tools (LLM Inference, Vector Embeddings, Oracle, Python Sandbox, Memory Vault) when no payment credential is configured.
